title: Chapter 548 - 548 News From All Sides; Results!
content:
Chapter 548 - 548 News From All Sides; Results!

Chapter 548 - 548 News from All Sides; Results!

548 News from All Sides; Results!

On Weibo.

The topic of Jiangbei University’s thief was still brewing.

More and more people joined the discussion.

Everyone’s emotions kept climbing.

They kept praising Tang Yuan.

There were even signs that the thief would be expelled immediately.

At this moment, a trending topic suddenly appeared on Weibo: [Nonsense!]

Bing: [Tang Yuan’s talking nonsense! video.mp4]

Xue: [Tang Yuan’s talking nonsense! video.mp4]

These were Xia Bing and Xia Xue’s newly registered accounts.

They were posts by new accounts, so how could they get any popularity?

However, their thoughts were that they had to let more people know that Lin Fan had been wronged!

Therefore, they used their own network technology to push the topic to the trending list.

This attracted a few comments.

Chaos: [F*ck! Tang Yuan’s spouting nonsense? He’s framing someone?]

Tian: [Framing? Commenter, why don’t you take a look at the situation first? There are only a few comments, but it became a trending topic. Isn’t that strange?]

The Charm of Nowhere: [That’s disgusting! The thief must have paid for this post! Moreover, he’s buying traffic! He even used two newly registered accounts to make these posts! Pah! Do you think that this will make everyone deny what you’ve done? Impossible!]

Flower: [Thief, I advise you to quickly go to jail and stop resisting!]

Comparing Heart: [Shameless thief! You actually blurred your face in the video. Since you’re taking things this far, then show your face! Are you afraid? You have a guilty conscience, huh? Pah!]

Did not show his face?

That was right!

Xia Bing and Xia Xue indeed did not reveal Lin Fan’s face.

That was because they had been observing Lin Fan’s information every day.

Gradually, Xia Bing and Xia Xue realized that Lin Fan did not like to be exposed on the internet. As a result, even though he had achieved such huge achievements, there was not a single photo of him on the internet.

In addition, Xia Bing and Xia Xue did not want to cause Lin Fan any negative effects.

What Xia Bing and Xia Xue did not know was that the video could be posted only because they had blurred Lin Fan’s face.

Otherwise, their video would not have appeared on the internet.

That was because Lin Fan had the super smart watch, Lil White, which was always carrying out Lin Fan’s orders. As long as any videos or photos of him appeared on the internet, they would be deleted immediately.

At this moment, the internet was attacking Lin Fan.

Even if Xia Bing and Xia Xue pushed the topic to the hot searches and even if there was video evidence, it was useless.

However, not long after…

Jiangbei News, Weibo News, Daily News, Hot News, and other major media outlets released the news at the same time.

[The Slander at Jiangbei University!]

The news released the surveillance footage of Lin Fan and Tang Yuan.

Then, they analyzed and summarized all the details, including how Tang Yuan had hired commenters. The content was clear and understandable.

Initially, after a day since the news broke, the people on the internet were boiling with excitement over the thief at Jiangbei University.

When they saw the new update, they immediately felt as if they had been doused with cold water.

Everyone calmed down again.

Lin Zi: [We seem to have been used?]

Huanhuan: [This…]

Ling Bo Qiu Tang: [What’s the real situation?]

Zhou Yan: [Why do I still feel that something is not right? This news article is all analysis and reasoning. In the end, it’s all speculation! If they wanted to report on this, they should also investigate it, right? At the very least, the outcome should be reported by the official department of Jiangbei University, right?]

No Sugar in Coffee: [The commenter above is right! The entire thing was strange! I suspect that the thief might have hired these verified accounts!

[I’ll analyze it here!

[This thief might be a young master of a large consortium. The reason why he did such a thing might be because of some special hobby!]

Cheng Cheng Cheng: [That’s impossible, right? These accounts seem to be official accounts.]

…

This was done by Song Jiaxin.

Even though she could not completely convince everyone, it made some people less radical.

…

While everyone was discussing, Jiangbei University’s official website also released an announcement.

Jiangbei University: [An announcement regarding the theft case at our school. Our school has attached great importance to this incident. After careful investigation, we’re now responding to the process and results of the incident.

[This incident started when Tang Yuan wanted to cut the queue. After the other party refused, Tang Yuan seemed to harbor hatred for the other party.

[Therefore, when they met again, Mr. Tang took a photo and took revenge.

[Later, because Tang Yuan wanted to use this opportunity to create a hot topic and become famous as an internet celebrity, he deliberately made a big deal out of the incident.

[Therefore, this incident has nothing to do with the man in the photo.

[The school has decided to give Tang Yuan a major demerit and put him on probation for framing someone.

[We hope all students will take this as a warning!

[Finally, we would like to thank everyone for paying attention to Jiangbei University.]

This announcement quickly attracted the attention and comments of countless people.

Fang Yuan: [Terrifying! It’s really a false accusation! Isn’t that too vile?]

Dazhuang’s Mother: [I was praising Tang Yuan so much, but he actually framed someone else!]

Watermelon: [He took revenge because the other party didn’t let him cut the queue? He’s too evil.]

Windy People: [This is too disgusting. Also, I hate it when people cut in line!]

Frosty: [Jiangbei University’s investigation is so fast this time, but is it true?]

…

Soon after, the Jiangbei Police Department also issued a similar announcement.

The Jiangbei Police Department: [After investigation, we can confirm that Tang Yuan did frame someone else.

[However, the police were not called for this.

[Now, Mr. Tang should publicly apologize to the other party on the internet.]

…

Soon, the post received many comments.

MMM: [So he really framed another person!]

Shallow Smile: [Winning public sympathy and wasting public resources!]

Lan Lingling: [If what some people said is true and that the thief is the young master of a big corporation… It’s terrifying to think about it!]

Wenwen: [Terrifying!]

…

Even though many major media outlets, Jiangbei University, and the Jiangbei Police Department had released news and announcements, they still did not gain everyone’s trust.

That was until midnight!

The Nation Daily posted on Weibo.
